The '''Devastator war droid''' was a class of [[Droid/Legends|android]] designed by [[Ubrikkian Steamworks]] as an upgrade to the [[sentinel droid]] around the time of the [[Old Sith Wars]]. A tough, well-built weapon, the Devastator contained redundant systems that minimized damage and allowed it to continue to fight at 85% combat efficiency even after taking significant damage. Due to its sophistication, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] restricted its sale to only military units, making it a rare sight in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Nonetheless, most models ended up in possession of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and criminals.
